invention_title: Canonical Prime Priority Cybergenetic Skill-DNA Authoring and Class Promotion System
technical_field: software architecture, workflow orchestration, audit-controlled skill registration, legal/financial readiness automation, operator-gated execution systems
problem_statement: AI/software workflows can generate capabilities without stable provenance, proof, class, or execution gates.
Financial/legal/fraud workflows require traceable authority, evidence, controls, and operator review before execution.
Existing automation often lacks a structured mechanism for earning trust before enabling money-preparation workflows.
solution_summary: A Canonical Prime Priority authority layer authors skill DNA.
Each skill DNA includes identity, purpose, inputs, outputs, controls, evidence, lineage, class, phase, and audit strands.
Respect scoring verifies artifacts before class promotion.
Operator execution remains separate from automated preparation.
JURIS continuity records preserve audit lineage.
disclosure_risk_note: Do not publish detailed enabling disclosure before attorney review if preserving patent rights matters.
